supported_context_single_chip.basis: Phase 1 of the design (models/demos/glm53_flash + ~/ashai/GLM_5.3_DESIGN.md): single-chip functional layers with the sparse DSA path validated at small scale (4K-16K); the advertised 1 048 576 positions are the Phase 2 multi-chip (8x4) contract with the user-partitioned paged latent cache.
supported_context_single_chip.hard_limit_note: Not a hard physical limit of one chip for a single user: the 11 DSA latent caches at 1 M positions need ~11 GB bf16 plus the 32 B/token pooled-key index, which fits the 32 GB per-chip DRAM next to one layer's weights; the single-chip limit here is validation time (the v1 composite prefill runs ~3 k tok/s per layer), not capacity.

largest_tested.prefill_evidence: tests/test_dsa_sparse.py: layer 3 (DSA+MoE) vs HF dump T4097, PCC 0.99977 (rows >= 2048: 0.99990); dense (<= 2048) path: layers 0/3/4 at 256 (PCC 0.99984 / 0.99992 / 0.99997), 1000 (DSA 0.99961, KDA 0.99995), 200 non-aligned (0.99980 / 0.99993)
largest_tested.decode_evidence: tests/test_dsa_sparse.py: sparse decode at 4097..4100, PCC 0.99995 / 0.99996 / 0.99993 / 0.99991; dense decode at 256..259 (layers 0/3/4), 1000..1002 (KDA, DSA), traced replay identical to eager

cache_and_position_semantics.kda_state: per user: recurrent [1,64,128,128] fp32 + conv history [1,3,24576] bf16, written by prefill into fixed user slots of a persistent [max_batch,...] state; decode updates all slots in place (trace-safe)
cache_and_position_semantics.dsa_latent_cache: paged [max_blocks,1,32,512] bf16 per layer, identity page table [max_batch, blocks_per_seq]; prefill fills a user's pages from position 0, decode appends at `positions[b]`
cache_and_position_semantics.dsa_index_cache: pooled keys [max_batch*pool_blocks,1,32,128] bf16 (one row per 4 tokens) + per-user 4-slot raw k/gate rings
cache_and_position_semantics.positions: int32 [B] device tensor = each user's current context length (position of the decode token); the sparse path additionally takes the same values as host ints
cache_and_position_semantics.mode_switch: DSA layers: dense exact attention while the query position < index_topk (2048), pooled-key indexer + top-2048 + tail selection beyond (matches HF: all visible tokens are selected below 2048)
cache_and_position_semantics.batch: fixed user slots: decode batch == max_batch; tested max_batch 1 and 2 (users with 100- and 37-token prompts)
